verdict.rationale: The Amazon Chime SDK is a real-time media SDK, so selective track subscription is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never documents a client or agent choosing to subscribe to one specific track independently of the publisher. The only subscription-related item describes automatic fallback to a lower-bitrate stream for bandwidth-constrained clients, which is an adjacent behavior, not per-track subscription.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent subscribes to a single track of a live broadcast without the publisher changing anything about how it publishes
